s.n: Speakeasy devilled eggs with crispy pancetta
s.note: Devilled eggs with a Dijon mayo yolk, crispy pancetta, smoked paprika
s.how: Boil 8 eggs for 10 minutes, cool in iced water, peel and halve. Mash the yolks with 80g mayonnaise, 2 tsp Dijon mustard, 1 tsp white vinegar, salt and a pinch of smoked paprika until smooth. Pipe or spoon back into the whites. Bake 8 slices of pancetta on a tray at 200C for 8 minutes until crisp, cool and break into shards. Top each egg with pancetta, a dusting of paprika and snipped chives.

s.note: Prawns poached in lemon water, chilled in iced water, served on ice
s.how: Bring a pot of salted water to the boil with lemon slices. Add 500g green prawns and poach for 2 minutes, then plunge into iced water. Peel and serve on ice with mayonnaise mixed with tomato sauce, lemon and hot sauce.

m.note: Grilled lobster tails with garlic butter, baby potatoes and green beans
m.how: Split 4 lobster tails and brush with butter mixed with crushed garlic. Grill for 6 minutes until just cooked. Boil 800g baby potatoes and steam green beans, then toss both with butter. Serve with lemon wedges. Well, nobody's perfect.

w.note: Three butter sponge layers with strawberry jam and whipped cream
w.how: Beat 300g butter with 300g sugar, add 5 eggs and fold in 300g self-raising flour. Bake in 3 tins at 175C for 25 minutes. Stack with strawberry jam and whipped cream, ice white and top with candles. Watch who jumps out.

d.note: Bourbon, sweet vermouth and bitters stirred cold, with a cherry
d.how: For each drink, stir 60ml bourbon, 30ml sweet vermouth and 2 dashes aromatic bitters with ice in a jug. Strain into chilled glasses and drop in a maraschino cherry. Use a jug, not a hot water bottle in an upper berth.
